triage.summary: Olivia Brown of Brown Bakery asks whether Alex can automate the cake order form to send orders to a Google Sheet and requests a cost estimate.

task.title: Reply with a quote for cake order automation
task.description: Olivia Brown of Brown Bakery asks Alex to automate the cake order form so orders land in a Google Sheet and wants to know the cost. Assess the scope and provide a quote.

reply.body:
Hi Olivia,

Thanks for reaching out. I can help with that. To estimate the cost, could you share a link to the order form and let me know how it’s currently hosted and what details you’d like captured in the Google Sheet?

Best,
Alex
